## Real-Debrid for Android & Android TV — v__VN__ (build __VC__)

Signed release APK. Works on phones, tablets, Chromebooks, **Android TV / Google TV / Fire TV** (remote control supported).

### Install
1. Download **RealDebrid.apk** below.
2. Open it, allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser/file manager once, tap **Install**.
3. TV: put the APK on a USB stick or use *Downloader* / *Send Files to TV*, then install.
4. Updates later: the app offers "Update available" and installs over the old version (same signing key).

If Google Play Protect says *"app not seen before"*, tap **More details → Install anyway** (every app installed outside Play Store shows this).

### Features
Link unrestrict • link check • magnets & .torrent • torrent manager • built-in ExoPlayer (FFmpeg codecs, subtitles, Chromecast) • pausable background downloads • hosts & quota • downloads history • app lock • TV remote navigation.
